confirmed_source_path: RequestResolver first non-HEADERS frame creates H3_FRAME_UNEXPECTED through handle_connection_error_on_stream.
The stream helper sets and wakes shared error; it does not close the transport.
serve_h3 returns Ok immediately on resolve_request error.

Server Connection Drop instead closes H3_NO_ERROR if that poll was skipped.
Quinn close_inner preserves the first transport close reason; a fatal close before Drop is therefore relevant.

open_and_rejected: No demonstrated vendor parser defect: the parser records the correct fatal error, but the caller does not drive its close.
